_about: Tests that fail on main today and are being worked on. CI reports these loudly on every run but does not let them block a merge; any OTHER failure still does, and an entry whose test starts passing is flagged for removal. Never add an entry to hide a new regression: it needs a reason and an owner who will look at it. See docs/TESTING.md.

tests.title: a partial payment writes the entered amount and keeps the plan as an estimate
tests.reason: After saving 3 200 of 9 200 the ledger row reads '+9 200 € est: 6 000 €'; the spec expects '3 200' with 'est: 9 200'. Money display: decide which one is intended, then fix the app or the spec.

tests.title: a status that moves no money commits straight away
tests.reason: A pending/overdue row now always shows 'est: 9 200 €'; the spec expects no 'est:' subtitle until money settles. Same question as the partial-payment test.

tests.title: cancelling the prompt leaves the row untouched
tests.reason: Same 'est:' subtitle on an untouched pending row as above.

tests.title: an edit made just before leaving is still saved
tests.reason: After rename + Back to list the project is still open (project-save-state present). Either the late save reopens the project (the regression this test guards) or Back is lost. Failed in both CI runs.

tests.title: the structure view reorders by drag
tests.reason: Drag in the structure view puts the last employee first instead of moving the first to the end. Fails on CI; unknown whether drag timing or the reorder logic.

tests.title: dragging a row in the structure reorders it
tests.reason: Dragging a project row does not change the order on CI. Same family as the employees drag.

tests.title: statuses are added, renamed and removed in settings, and the projects list follows
tests.reason: The projects list still shows the five built-in statuses after the settings edits. Known to fail on 95b760dc too.

tests.title: one click settles the rest of the value as a paid income row
tests.reason: The 'mark rest as paid' button is not found on project-1 finances. Known to fail on 95b760dc too.

tests.title: archiving a task from its drawer keeps the edits made in the drawer
tests.reason: Drawer opens and the title is edited, but no archived task is pushed afterwards; the hold-to-confirm archive may not complete on CI.

tests.title: a background pull does not wipe a product card being edited
tests.reason: The product name input is not found after unlocking the card (input[value=...]:enabled).

tests.title: Leads / Pipeline
tests.reason: Crawler: the 'Obľúbené leady vždy ako prvé' dropdowns open no panel. Check whether they are real dropdowns or crawler false positives.
